name: arya-agent
comment:overrides: Pin a single React (Expo SDK 54's version) across the workspace. Without this, a transitive dep hoists a newer react@19.2.x at the root while the companion pins 19.1.0 — two React instances break react-native-css-interop's context so NativeWind className styles silently stop applying. See memory: companion-nativewind-duplicate-react.
